tools.name: go_goroutine_compare
tools.description: Compares two goroutine dumps of one Go program taken some time apart, and shows which stacks are growing and which goroutine IDs never moved, which is stronger evidence of a leak than one dump. It never connects to the program.

before_path.description: Path to a file with the earlier dump

after_path.description: Path to a file with the later dump

tools.name: go_goroutine_review
tools.description: Finds what a stuck or leaking Go program is waiting on, from a goroutine dump: /debug/pprof/goroutine?debug=2 or debug=1, a panic traceback, or SIGQUIT output. Groups identical stacks, separates normal idle goroutines, and flags channel leaks, lock pile-ups with possible holders, WaitGroups that never finish, full database pools, HTTP calls with no timeout and nil channels. It only reads the text you give it and never connects to the program. Findings are leads.

dump.description: Goroutine dump text. Give this or path

path.description: Path to a file holding a goroutine dump. Prefer this for large dumps. Give this or dump
